issue.title: Give sase agent list gate-aware status like the TUI
issue.description:
`sase agent list` and the integrations listing project a settled gate-shell member as plain `DONE` instead of the gate's start/stop status (for example `TALE APPROVED`) and instead of the handoff-aware status bucket the TUI now uses.

The listing path is `src/sase/integrations/_agent_list_entry_builder.py`. `record_status_bucket` (around line 62) and `build_agent_list_entry` (around line 99) have monitor-aware status and bucket derivation, but no gate equivalent: `_base_record_status` returns `"DONE"` for any non-failed done marker, including `outcome="gated"`.

This is the remaining parity gap after the TUI/gate-shell member-row bucket fix in `plan:202608/gate_shell_handoff_status_bucket.md`. That tale keeps `GATE_STATE_BUCKETS` and the TUI loaders in scope and explicitly leaves this listing surface out.

Repro: after an approved tale gate shell settles (`gate_state=answered`, `gate_stop_status=TALE APPROVED`), ACE shows `TALE APPROVED` in the Running group, while `sase agent list` still reports `DONE`.

task_type_fields.proposal: Give `sase agent list` and the integrations listing the same gate-shell status and status-bucket projection the TUI uses: a gate member should show its effective gate status (`TALE` / `TALE APPROVED` / `ANSWERED` / …) and, for handoff-settled statuses, the `Running` bucket rather than a generic `DONE`.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved tale `plan:202608/gate_shell_handoff_status_bucket.md` only fixes the TUI member-row and `GateShellRecord.status_bucket` projections. The listing builder is a separate, larger surface with its own status derivation, done-marker handling, and no existing gate equivalent. Widening that tale would mix two contracts.

payload.description: adjacent shell:gate listing/search surface, not the same status-bucket gap
